metadata.assembly_architecture: Each character portrait is vertically assembled from 4 non-overlapping edge-to-edge horizontal slices: A_TopHair (upper head/hair crown) -> B_FaceEye (eyes strip) -> C_FaceMouth (mouth/chin strip) -> D_Body (neck/torso/uniform). The C03 series is full-scale (matching CHARA_03_SPxx_A and CHARA_03_SPxx_D directly), whereas the CW03 series is downscaled to ~58.5% for 16:9 Widescreen display mode.
